title: Mini Data Pack
description: This project adds an easy way to start Life Series or Event Minirounds!
body:
# Mini Pack!
This is MiniPack, by [Legacy Life Series](https://discord.gg/rh6YgANQ3).


Any Issues? Visit [here](https://forms.gle/CutAruCUz44v7nW79)
## 🎮 It's for... 🎮
MiniPack is made for Minecraft "Life Series" minirounds!

## ❤️ A "Life Series" is... 💚
The "Life Series" is a Minecraft SMP, where you have a certain amount of lives.
To play the Life Series visit the mod! [Click here to visit it!](https://modrinth.com/mod/life-series)

There are currently 7 seasons of the "Life Series", Ranging from 3 lives to 24 hours to live.

[Here is the Life Series Wiki, if you want to know more.](https://the-life-series.fandom.com/wiki/The_Life_Series_Wiki)

## 💬 Commands 🗨️
Currently only one command, but I am working on version 2 which adds another one.

/function mini : Starts the mini, tps everyone to you, sets them to survival and gives them whatever you have in your first slot


/function setup : Sets the worldborder 150, and sets the worldborder center to you.

/function tags : Sends my tags

## New
We have officially gone live on Modrinth,
Version 2.01 has gone live!
